notes: «- هو الطيالسي» is an editor gloss with no closing dash in the text; it is left out and «عباد بن منصور» is read as the next link.
«وزعم أن النبي» and «وقد روي من غير وجه» are remarks by the narrator and the compiler with no isnad of their own; they are not links.
«قال أبو عيسى» is the compiler's grading, not a link.
